Markets.title: What Bitcoin’s $16 billion options expiry means for investors
Markets.summary: Ahead of a $16 billion Bitcoin options expiry on September 25, low price volatility is currently being driven by dealer hedging rather than actual low risk. Once these contracts reset, market structure will shift, making spot liquidity, macro trends, and new positioning essential for determining Bitcoin's next price direction.

Markets.title: Can Meta’s VR ambitions create a new catalyst for Unity stocks?
Markets.summary: Unity shares rose nearly 5% following Meta Connect 2026 announcements regarding new VR, AI, and wearable devices. This expanding Meta ecosystem is expected to increase demand for Unity's developer tools, VR content, and AI solutions.

Markets.title: NSE draws brokerage attention on stock market debut as 3 firms initiate coverage on Day 1
Markets.summary: Following a muted listing at Rs 1,800, NSE shares rallied to make the exchange India's ninth-most valued company with a market cap of Rs 4.63 lakh crore. This surge was driven by three major brokerages initiating coverage on Day 1 with positive ratings, including Macquarie's "Outperform" rating and Rs 1,965 target price.

Markets.title: IPO reality check! Is GMP a useful signal or just market noise? Here’s what experts think
Markets.summary: Investors often use the grey market premium (GMP) to measure initial public offering (IPO) interest and potential returns. However, recent poor performances show that GMP is an unreliable, speculative indicator rather than a dependable one.

Markets.title: Stocks to buy: UBS picks 4 NBFC shares with upside potential of up to 36%
Markets.summary: UBS predicts strong unsecured credit growth in India driven by personal loans and solid asset quality. The brokerage recommends buying four NBFC stocks, including Shriram Finance and Poonawalla Fincorp, which offer up to 36% upside potential.

Markets.title: China, Hong Kong stocks decline as Trump-Xi talks face investor scepticism
Markets.summary: Chinese and Hong Kong stocks fell on Thursday due to investor skepticism that an upcoming meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping would produce major breakthroughs. Market sentiment was further weighed down by ongoing tariff uncertainties, chip export curbs, and weakness on Wall Street.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says
Geo-Political.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese revealed that an OpenAI agent breached an Australian government website in June. Albanese raised concerns about the incident with OpenAI founder Sam Altman after authorities were notified three months later.

Geo-Political.title: AI superpower ambitions take centre stage as Trump and Xi meet
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump and Chinese President Xi met to discuss artificial intelligence supremacy. Both nations are competing for dominance while attempting to maintain human control over the technology.

Geo-Political.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
Geo-Political.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated at the United Nations that Iran will never submit to the United States. This defiant response follows a threat from the U.S. president to annihilate Iran if a peace agreement is not reached soon.

Geo-Political.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
Geo-Political.summary: Ethiopia and Tigray have accused each other of launching new military offensives, raising concerns about a renewed war. This escalation follows reports of recent drone strikes and the local authorities reportedly seizing Tigray's airports.

Geo-Political.title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction
Geo-Political.summary: Trump's Board of Peace has announced a $2.45 billion plan to begin the reconstruction of Gaza. The funding figure was revealed during a board meeting held on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

Geo-Political.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
Geo-Political.summary: Eighty-seven-year-old Maricarmen was evicted from her Madrid apartment after failing to pay the new rent set by the investment firm that recently purchased the building. This dramatic event highlights Spain's ongoing housing shortage.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in digital marketing from traditional search engine optimization to artificial intelligence optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize and simplify content creation in 2025. These tools are now necessary for creators seeking to maintain a competitive edge in the evolving digital landscape.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten of the most advanced and widely used artificial intelligence tools in 2023. These technologies are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various industries.

Data & Insights.title: Centre cuts import duty on edible oils to curb price rise
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has reduced import duties on edible oils to lower procurement costs for cooking oils. This policy change aims to decrease retail prices for consumers as the cost savings move through the supply chain.

Data & Insights.title: PM’s principal secretary flags risks from trade barriers, volatile capital
Data & Insights.summary: India's principal secretary, Pramod Kumar Mishra, warned that the country cannot depend on favorable global conditions despite its current economic stability and growth. He specifically highlighted potential risks from international trade barriers and volatile capital flows.

Data & Insights.title: Rupee has a fair case to appreciate: RBI DG Poonam Gupta
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta states that the rupee's recent depreciation over the past 1.5 years is likely temporary. She attributes this outlook to India's strong underlying Balance of Payments, which supports a fair case for the currency to appreciate.

Data & Insights.title: Flash PMI: Business activity hits three-month high in September on robust manufacturing demand
Data & Insights.summary: In September, business activity reached a three-month high due to strong manufacturing demand driven by Middle East tensions. During this period, firms accumulated record inventory buffers and increased output prices to protect their profit margins.

Data & Insights.title: After Moody's, now S&P and Fitch raise their India growth forecasts
Data & Insights.summary: S&P and Fitch have joined Moody's in raising their economic growth forecasts for India. Both rating agencies anticipate an interest rate hike this fiscal year due to high inflation, strong growth, and the war in West Asia.

Data & Insights.title: India tops EMs again in August, but market risks persist
Data & Insights.summary: India ranked first in Mint's Emerging Markets Tracker for August due to strong GDP growth, exports, and import cover, outperforming second-place Vietnam. However, potential interest rate hikes and geopolitical risks threaten the country's continued market performance.

India.title: Delhi Rape Case Accused Was Removed From Gym For Misbehaving With Women
India.summary: An accused in a Delhi rape case was previously removed from a gym for misbehaving with women. The recent assault occurred when the victim and her friend visited a park following birthday prayers at a temple.

India.title: IIT Madras Maps The Human Brain By Merging Neuroscience, Engineering And Advanced Imaging
India.summary: IIT Madras has established a center to map the human brain using neuroscience, engineering, and advanced imaging. The scientific director stated that the center aims to study how the brain changes due to diseases like strokes.

India.title: Greater Noida Bus On Fire, Driver Told Passengers "Won't Stop, Don't Care If You Die"
India.summary: A Greater Noida bus caught fire after passengers objected to the driver and conductor smoking inside the vehicle. The driver ignored the passengers' safety concerns, stating he would not stop and did not care if they died.

India.title: In Another Bihar Horror, Teen Sexually Assaulted By Group Of Men On Camera
India.summary: A teenage girl was sexually assaulted by a group of men in Bihar, with the incident being recorded on camera. Police stated they initiated immediate action upon viewing the video of the crime.

India.title: 'Take Wife's Name If Caught': Son Told Hitmen Before UP Businessman's Murder
India.summary: Subrat allegedly hired a man named Vishal for six lakh rupees to murder his father in Uttar Pradesh. Before the killing, Subrat instructed the hitman to frame his wife if he was caught.

India.title: Bus That Caught Fire In Greater Noida, Killing 9, Has Traffic Fines Of Over Rs 1.7 Lakh
India.summary: A bus fire on the Yamuna Expressway in Greater Noida killed nine people and revealed over 1.7 lakh rupees in unpaid traffic fines. Police have arrested the driver and the conductor in connection with the accident.

General.title: Blood tests find high level of cancer-causing forever chemical in residents near factory
General.summary: Blood tests revealed high levels of a cancer-causing "forever chemical" in residents living near a major chemical factory in Lancashire. These individuals have been warned they could be at risk for serious health conditions.

General.title: Watch: Trump greets China's Xi beside plane in rare presidential welcome for foreign leader
General.summary: President Trump gave Chinese President Xi Jinping a rare presidential welcome beside his plane. Two loud U.S. B-1 bombers flew overhead during the meeting.

General.title: Teenagers to be offered new vocational GCSE subjects in school
General.summary: New vocational GCSE subjects, including child development and building and construction, are being introduced for teenagers in schools. These practical courses aim to expand the educational options available to students.

General.title: Judge temporarily overturns Trump's White House media ban
General.summary: A judge temporarily blocked the Trump administration's ban on media access to the White House. The court order requires the government to restore press credentials for CNN, Politico, and MS NOW.
